brief:
The Peace Council will reveal a reconstruction plan valued at $2.45 billion for Gaza, according to Maan Wire. Details of the proposal's scope, timeline, and implementation mechanisms were not immediately available.

The announcement comes as Gaza faces extensive infrastructure damage from ongoing conflict. The scale of the proposed investment reflects assessments of reconstruction needs across the territory's housing, health, education, and utility sectors.
title: Peace Council to unveil $2.45 billion Gaza reconstruction plan
